[P2] Reconcile event suppression with the stated design decision

Rule 7, **List the decisions that the task did not cover**, is not satisfied here. This guard suppresses the entire event when type and message are absent, including stack-trace-only errors. However, the PR description explicitly relies on the event remaining present and says the replacement test asserts an empty attribute set. The maintainer is therefore presented with a different observable contract, without a stated decision covering discarded stack-trace diagnostics. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, document the chosen behavior and rationale for these cases, and obtain agreement before further implementation.
